summary: Air-date lane only, and much bigger than the two flagged rows. Rows 110–115 hold the right SIX dates but permuted: stored {110:08-10, 111:07-27, 112:08-03} against the true {110:07-27, 111:08-03, 112:08-10}, and stored {113:08-24, 114:08-31, 115:08-17} against the true {113:08-17, 114:08-24, 115:08-31} — two independent 3-cycles inside two blocks of three. ja-WP's 名探偵コナンのアニメエピソード一覧 and Detective Conan World's Season 3 table agree episode-for-episode, and rows 109 (07-13), 116 (09-07) and 117 (09-14) are already correct, which pins both ends. Six repairs, no true deviation.

repairs.why: ja-WP: |7月27日||110||料理教室殺人事件（前編）; DCW Season 3 {{SeasonItem|110|116|Cooking Classroom Murder Case (Part 1)|July 27, 1998}}. (DCW's first argument is the Jp# column, which is our row space; the second, 116, is the Int# column — do not key on it.)
ja-WP: |8月3日||111||料理教室殺人事件（後編）; DCW Season 3: Jp# 111 = August 3, 1998. A two-parter cannot straddle 07-27 and 08-10 with 08-03 given to a different case.
ja-WP: |8月10日||112||帝丹小7不思議事件; DCW Season 3: Jp# 112 'The Seven Mysteries of Teitan Elementary School Case' = August 10, 1998.
ja-WP: |8月17日||113||白い砂浜殺人事件; DCW Season 3: Jp# 113 'The White Sandy Beach Murder Case' = August 17, 1998.
ja-WP: |8月24日||114||スキューバダイビング殺人事件（前編）; DCW Season 3: Jp# 114 = August 24, 1998.
ja-WP: |8月31日||115||スキューバダイビング殺人事件（後編）; DCW Season 3: Jp# 115 = August 31, 1998. Ep 116 (09-07) is already correct in our data, so 08-31 is the only slot left.

structure.notes: Our rows 109-117 match ja-WP 第N話 and DCW's Jp# column 1:1 by title. DCW's second SeasonItem argument (Int#) runs +6 here and must never be joined on (batch-17 ruling).

flags_for_sean: The gate flagged only 111 and 115, but the true defect spans 110-115: each block of three (110-112 and 113-115) has its dates rotated within the block. Applying only the two flagged rows would leave four wrong dates that happen to be monotone. All six repairs should go together.
1998-07-20 is a genuine no-episode week (ja-WP and DCW both jump 07-13 -> 07-27). Not a deviation, just a gap.
